messages:
samir: noticed a spike of 503s hitting hosted inference around 03:24 UTC, looks like the upstream runner on gw-34 restarted repeatedly. Customers reporting timeouts + 500/503. attaching initial logs.
lee: on it. can you drop the container logs? was this a single model or multi-model fleet?
samir: primarily hitting model rdx-pegasus-13b (quantized variant). multiple hosts in pool but gw-34 shows repeated restarts.
samir: paste logs:
```
[03:24:12] runtime: segfault at 0x7ffd1a2f, signal 11
[03:24:12] kernel: coredump written to /var/crash/gw-34/runner.1234.core
[03:24:12] runtime: failed to allocate 512MB for KV cache
[03:24:12] docker: exit status 139
[03:24:13] watchdog: restart container (count=4)
```
mike: segfault + failed allocation looks like GPU OOM or host OOM in kernel. but "failed to allocate 512MB" suggests our KV prefetcher tried to grow aggressively. any recent config changes to cache size?
priya: no config changes in prod. We deployed a quantization profile last night that changed the model chunking behavior — might increase KV usage temporarily.
samir: repro steps (non-prod):
1) request long context (8k) to rdx-pegasus-13b-quant
2) batch size 8 concurrent
3) repeat ~50 req/s
observed memory climb until coredump.
lee: good repro, thanks. nora can you check autoscaler logs and eviction events on gw-34?
nora: autoscaler shows no OOM kill from kube, but docker logs show repeated SIGSEGV in inference process. I also see GPU-mem reported at near-capacity just before crash on nividia-smi snapshot.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2159. Priority: P1. Notify: @eng-runtime @oncall @cs_escalation
cs_escalation: customer facing - 3 accounts reported high latency and 503s, one launched an incident with their SRE. they want ETA.
lee: immediate mitigations: (1) remove gw-34 from traffic via routing tag, (2) roll back quant profile to prior version on fleet, (3) enable fallback to a lower-memory model variant. which is low-effort?
mike: we can remove host via /opsctl drain-host gw-34 in ~30s. rollback of quant profile needs a deploy and might take ~5-10m. fallback routing can be toggled config side in ~2m if we have route to rdx-pegasus-13b-fp16.
samir: I'm draining gw-34 now.
```
$ opsctl drain-host gw-34 --force
draining gw-34
```
samir: gw-34 out of rotation. new 503 rate dropped by ~70% within 1m.
priya: pushing rollback to quant profile now. rolling update to model variant rdx-pegasus-13b-quant@v2026-03-15 -> v2026-03-12
nora: deploy started, ~6 hosts updating.
engin-runtime: can you capture core, run gdb on runner binary and get backtrace? put core in ephemeral storage and attach.
mike: got a backtrace snippet from gdb:
```
#0  0x00007f6f2a1a3c7e in kv_cache::grow() at kv_cache.cpp:243
#1  0x00007f6f2a1b2d4f in inference::prefetch_kv() at prefetch.cpp:88
#2  0x00007f6f2a0b7f10 in attention_kernel::compute() at attn_kernel.cu:412
#3  0x00007f6f2a0b8f2e in __cudaLaunchKernel
```
mike: looks like kv_cache::grow (C++) tried to allocate host memory for pinned pages and triggered a condition that ended up causing segfault on subsequent cuda copy.
priya: rollback completed, versions back to v2026-03-12; traffic to rolled hosts steady.
lee: CS please confirm whether to notify affected customers with an interim RCA or wait for root cause analysis. @cs_escalation
cs_escalation: customers want immediate note and mitigation status. we'll send a brief update: drained host, rollback applied, monitoring.
samir: capturing additional telemetry: kv cache growth rates, per-request KV hit/miss, sequence lengths. saved to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/2159876543/telemetry.tar.gz
nora: I also pulled docker inspect and host free/mem snapshots; see /internal/storage/incidents/2159876543/host_snapshot.json
engin-runtime: I'll reproduce locally with the quantized binary and the same sequence lengths; trying to force the allocation path. if reproducible we'll add checks to cap KV growth.
mike: quick workaround idea: add guard in runtime to enforce max KV prefetch allocation per-request based on available GPU mem. we can push a hotfix to hosted runtime today if tests pass.
lee: agree. priority: verify fix in staging then hotfix to prod. estimated time: staging tests 2-3h, prod deploy 30m.
oncall-bot: paging engin-runtime oncall (priority paging) because this is P1.
engin-runtime: pulled a repro run in staging; when running 50 concurrent long-context requests I can reproduce OOM and segfault in 12-15min. adding a guard reduces memory climb and avoids crash in 30m run.
priya: are there logs correlating with quant chunking change? we should mark this regression as a release blocker for the quant profile.
lee: filed bug: RDX-1964 - kv prefetch growth unbounded with quant chunking -> segfault. blocking further quant profile rollouts until patch.
samir: timeline summary for CS:
- 03:24 UTC: customers observed 503/500
- 03:25 UTC: identified repeated runner segfaults on gw-34; drained host
- 03:30 UTC: rollback quant profile across fleet; 503s reduced
- 03:45 UTC: telemetry collected and cores analyzed; root cause narrowed to KV prefetch growth with quant chunking
- mitigation: host drain + rollback; hotfix in progress
cs_escalation: sending update to customers now. will include workaround and ETA for hotfix.
nora: arch note: this is subtle interaction between memory accounting and quantized model chunk sizes — need better simulated load tests for quant profiles.
mike: postmortem action items:
- add guard in kv_cache to cap allocation and fail gracefully
- add unit e2e test for large context + concurrent load on quant profiles
- add telemetry alarm for per-host kv cache growth
lee: assigning owners: mike -> runtime fix, priya -> release gating for quant profiles, nora -> monitoring + alarms, samir -> followup doc + postmortem
samir: thanks all. I'll open the postmortem doc and link logs. keeping this thread open for updates.
cs_escalation: sent interim update to customers at 04:00 UTC. they acknowledged and requested root cause + timeline when available. :thumbsup:
engin-runtime: hotfix branch created, running CI. will notify here when merged to prod.
mike: merged hotfix to canary at 07:10 UTC, no regressions so far. rolling to prod in 30m.
samir: prod deploy completed at 07:45 UTC, monitoring shows stable memory and no further segfaults on runner fleet. marking incident as resolved in Ops dashboard pending postmortem.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2159 status: mitigated -> resolved (pending postmortem).
